page_title: VIL 3-2 SEV | Villarreal v Sevilla 11/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+7' The referee is firm and issues Sergio Ramos (Sevilla) a deserved yellow card.

90+7' 3 - 2 Alex Baena produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box, where Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) rises high to head the ball into the right side of the goal and beyond the goalkeeper. He makes it 3:2.
90+5' Isidro Diaz de Mera shows a yellow card to Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) for his blatant foul.
90+4' The goal by Villarreal is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
90+3' Wait! Referee Isidro Diaz de Mera has indicated he is going to review the Villarreal goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
90+2' Ramon Terrats (Villarreal) uses his strength and awareness to get the better of the defender and coolly scores from the resulting corner kick.
90+2' The ball is out of play. Villarreal win a corner kick.
90+1' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Villarreal was in an offside position.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' The Sevilla players’ joy was short-lived as the original decision is reversed after a VAR review by referee Isidro Diaz de Mera. NO PENALTY!
88' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to Sevilla, he's going to review using VAR.
88' Eric Bailly (Villarreal) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
88' Kike Salas (Sevilla) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
87' Handball! A player from Villarreal handled the ball. Penalty! A huge opportunity to score for Sevilla.
87' Sevilla quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

85' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from near the penalty spot wasn't accurate enough and the ball glanced away off the left post!

84' 2 - 2 It's a goal! Yerson Mosquera (Villarreal) scores with a brilliant shot into the middle of the goal after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Ramon Terrats. The score is now 2:2.
83' One of the Sevilla players commits a holding foul and the referee reaches for his whistle.
82' Marcelino prepares a substitution. Goncalo Guedes is replaced by Jose Luis Morales (Villarreal).
82' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Jorge Cuenca walks off the pitch to be replaced by Etienne Capoue (Villarreal).
82' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Villarreal.

80' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) looks very eager to impress, does well to beat his man and force a cross into the box, where one of his teammates gets his head on the ball, but it's too easy for the keeper.
77' Villarreal take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
76' Having seen unsporting behavior, Isidro Diaz de Mera shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Pepe Reina (Villarreal) is the recipient.
75' Quique Sanchez Flores has decided to make a change. Joan Jordan (Sevilla) replaces Suso.
75' It is time for a substitution. Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) is on for Lucas Ocampos.
73' A lofted pass finds Alex Baena (Villarreal) free in the box, but his first-time effort sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
72' Villarreal try to speed play up by taking a quick free kick.
71' A player from Sevilla commits a rough challenge. Isidro Diaz de Mera blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. That's a free kick to Villarreal.
70' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.

67' What a chance that is! Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.
64' Here is a change. Ilias Akhomach is going off and Marcelino gives the last tactical orders to Bertrand Traore (Villarreal).
63' Marcos Acuna doesn't have to suffer any longer with the painful injury as Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) comes onto the pitch to replace him.
63' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jorge Cuenca (Villarreal) was quite harsh and Isidro Diaz de Mera didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
61' Marcos Acuna (Sevilla) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
60' The attendance for today's match is 16862.
59' Villarreal take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
57' One of the Sevilla players was holding his opponent and the referee doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
54' Sevilla are ruled offside.
52' Jorge Cuenca (Villarreal) misses a great chance after he found some space in the box! His glancing header goes over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
52' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Villarreal comes to nothing.
52' Kiko Femenia (Villarreal) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Villarreal.
51' Ramon Terrats (Villarreal) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
50' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Villarreal is cautioned for aggressive play.

46' Alex Baena (Villarreal) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards towards the right side of the goal, but Orjan Nyland is well positioned and easily deals with the effort.
46' Marcelino has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Ramon Terrats comes on the pitch for Francis Coquelin (Villarreal).
46' Referee Isidro Diaz de Mera blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Suso (Sevilla) fails to deliver a cross from the free kick as his attempt is thwarted by the opposition's defence.
45+1' Isidro Diaz de Mera has a clear sight and sees a foul from Alex Baena (Villarreal). Sevilla are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.

44' 1 - 2 Goal! Jesus Navas plays a neat lofted pass into the box for Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla), who beats the defender in the air and plants a header into the right side of the goal from close range. 1:2.
40' The game is interrupted as Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) is flagged offside.
38' Isidro Diaz de Mera interrupts the game. One of the players from Villarreal won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
36' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) latches onto a cross inside the box but fires a poor effort high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
34' Villarreal failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

33' Alex Baena (Villarreal) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. The ball goes out of play. Villarreal are awarded a corner kick.

30' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) bursts into the box to get on the end of a whipped in cross from Jorge Cuenca and scores magnificently from close range into the left side of the goal. 1:1.
27' A player from Villarreal commits a rough challenge. Isidro Diaz de Mera blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
26' 0 - 1 Goal! Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) puts the ball into the bottom left corner past the outstretched arm of Filip Jorgensen.
25' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Kiko Femenia (Villarreal) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. A penalty is given to Sevilla!
24' Isidro Diaz de Mera interrupts the game. One of the players from Villarreal won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
22' The total number of attempts is 6:0. The number of shots on goal at present is 1:0.
19' Yerson Mosquera (Villarreal) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
17' Villarreal produce a short pass from the free kick.
17' Tanguy Nianzou (Sevilla) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Isidro Diaz de Mera had an easy-decision to make.
15' Alex Baena (Villarreal) releases a decent shot towards the middle of the goal from the edge of the box, but it's comfortably gathered by Orjan Nyland.

14' Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) rises high to meet a perfect cross, but luckily for the goalkeeper he steers his header just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.
13' A quickly taken corner by Villarreal.
13' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Villarreal, is intercepted by one of the defenders. Villarreal get a corner.
12' Marcos Acuna (Sevilla) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Villarreal are awarded the free kick.
11' Goncalo Guedes (Villarreal) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
10' The resulting set piece from Villarreal is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
9' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal have been awarded a corner kick.
8' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
8' Villarreal work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
5' Marcos Acuna (Sevilla) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Isidro Diaz de Mera no option but to blow his whistle.
2' The Sevilla players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Sevilla will kick-off.
Isidro Diaz de Mera will supervise the game today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
